baseline_objective.reference_explanation: original (unmodified) sample, same fixed LIME seed
baseline_objective.spearman_universe: all 42 features: LIME weights are filled with 0.0 for any feature LIME omits, ranks of |weight| use average ranks for ties, rho = Pearson correlation of the ranks
baseline_objective.top10: features ranked by |LIME weight| descending, ties broken by feature name

dataset_sha256_note: keys refer to FILE NAMES. In this repository the files are swapped: UNSW_NB15_training-set.csv holds the 82,332-row official TEST set and UNSW_NB15_testing-set.csv the 175,341-row official TRAIN set. Loaders assign roles by row count.

evaluation_accounting.duplicates: v1 only: candidates already evaluated are skipped without a new explanation call
evaluation_accounting.explanation_budget: explanation_calls <= max_explanation_evaluations for both methods (baseline included)
evaluation_accounting.random_attempt_cap: random control stops after max_random_attempts proposal attempts

mutation_policy: mutation_proposal_v1: step = fraction*max(1,|original|); rounding only for constraints.INTEGER_FEATURES; values within 1e-09*max(1,|original|) of the original snap to the exact original
strategy_description: bounded greedy first-improvement coordinate search with a matched best-of-N random control; v1: targeted and random proposals both scored against the original explanation
